definitions: A mark, a line, or a sign indicating the former presence, existence, or occurrence of something; a vestige.
A very small quantity of something.
Either of two straps, chains, or ropes of a harness, extending from the collar or breastplate to the whippletree or a similar part of a vehicle or a plough.
A path or a route followed by someone or something.
examples: There was no trace of forced entry.
The water contained traces of lead.
The horse pulled the cart by its traces.
They followed the trace of the deer through the snow.
